changeinfo.changes:
Standby Support Restored:
Standby mode is now supported again while VitaUSBStream is active. Standby works in both Screen On and Screen Off modes. In Screen On mode, the display turns back on normally when the PS Vita wakes up. In Screen Off mode, the display may briefly turn on during wake-up, then VitaUSBStream immediately turns it off again. USB video streaming resumes normally after wake-up when the host reconnects the video stream. If the video does not automatically return in OBS or another capture application, switch to another video source/device and then switch back to VitaUSBStream to restart the stream.
